structure.overview: The case concerns a judicial review application by Little Black Bear First Nation against Kawacatoose First Nation and Standing Buffalo First Nation regarding a bill of costs assessment. The Federal Court of Appeal dismissed the judicial review applications and ordered the applicant, Little Black Bear First Nation, to pay costs to the respondents. The court addressed various contested cost items and ultimately allowed specific units and expenses claimed by the respondents, including printing costs, while disallowing others.
